blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Thorough evaluation of vision–language models (VLMs) has become prohibitively expensive, as benchmarks span an ever-broader spectrum of capabilities and new models arrive at a relentless pace.
Benchmark compression methods that preserve model rankings at a fraction of the cost are well studied for language models, but for VLMs the question remains under-explored.
We present PRIMEBench ( P runing R edundant I tems for M ultimodal E valuation), a vision-aware hierarchical benchmark compression framework that substantially reduces evaluation cost while preserving model rankings.
This hierarchical framework operates in four stages: data cleaning to remove items answerable without the image and all-correct items, category representative selection to pick one benchmark per capability category, item pruning with Vision-Aware Variance (VAW), and category-count pruning.
VAW combines inter-model variance with a vision-dependence score computed from multimodal embeddings alone, while encouraging coverage of diverse items within each benchmark. On models held out from item selection, it has the highest mean fidelity at the released 5 % 5\% retention.
The hierarchical design lets practitioners stop at any stage to match their compute budget; the released suite removes over 97 % 97\% of items while preserving model rankings.
Beyond compression, our analyses show how VLM evaluation behaves as model panels grow and evolve, providing guidance for designing future benchmarks that are more efficient, robust to model turnover, and explicit about the limits of evaluation-side pruning.

对语言模型进行了很好的研究,但对于VLMs来说,问题仍未得到充分探讨。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A single full-suite evaluation of a modern vision–language model (VLM) now consumes hundreds of GPU-hours. The benchmark landscape has expanded far beyond traditional visual question answering ( Goyal et al., 2017 ; Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) to include GUI and web understanding for vision agents ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ) , with new categories emerging rapidly alongside advances in agentic and embodied AI. Consequently, every new model release must be evaluated against an ever-growing suite of benchmarks, causing evaluation costs to compound.
blocks.zh: 对现代视觉-语言模型(VLM)进行单一的全程评价,现在消耗了数百个GPU小时. 基准景观已经远远超出了传统的视觉问答(Goyal等人,2017年;Hudson and Manning,2019年),包括了视觉代理的GUI和网络理解(Cheng等人,2024年;Koh等人,2024年),新的类别与代理性的进步一起迅速出现,并体现了AI. 因此,必须根据不断增加的一套基准来评价每一个新模式的发布,使评价费用复杂化。

blocks.en: In this work, we study the problem of compressing VLM benchmarks for efficient evaluation. Such compression is possible because VLM benchmarks exhibit redundancy at two levels. First, across benchmarks , the model-benchmark score matrix is markedly low-rank, suggesting that many benchmarks measure overlapping capabilities. Second, within benchmarks , many items contribute little discriminative signal, because they are unimportant or redundant with other items. Although several prior works have explored benchmark compression using these redundancies, they focus exclusively on within-benchmark redundancy ( Polo et al., 2024 ; Kipnis et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Moreover, only a handful of studies consider compression for VLM benchmarks, and none validates benchmark-level compression at large scale ( Uebayashi et al., 2026 ; Joshi et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们研究压缩VLM基准以进行有效评价的问题. 这种压缩是可能的,因为VLM基准在两个级别显示冗余. 首先,跨基准,模型-基准分数矩阵的排名明显较低,这表明许多基准衡量重叠能力。 第二,在基准范围内,许多项目几乎没有产生任何歧视性的信号,因为它们与其他项目无关重要或多余。 虽然之前的几部作品利用这些冗余探索了基准压缩,但它们只专注于基准内冗余(Polo等人,2024年;Kipnis等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年). 此外,只有少数研究考虑对VLM基准进行压缩,没有任何研究验证大规模的基准级压缩(Uebayashi等人,2026年;Joshi等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose PRIMEBench , a hierarchical benchmark compression framework for VLMs, supported by large-scale evaluations. Our method exploits across- and within-benchmark redundancies. Across benchmarks, benchmarks within a capability category induce highly correlated model rankings ( Liang et al., 2022 ; Polo et al., 2024 ) ; we replace each category with a single representative benchmark and exhaustively select a compact subset that preserves the full-suite ordering.
Within benchmarks, items solved by all models or failed by all carry no separation signal, while items with high inter-model variance dominate ranking quality; the all-wrong tail has a diagnostic role for future VLM evaluation.
We exploit these redundancies with one VLM-specific consideration: criteria for text-only large language models (LLMs) cannot tell apart items whose answer requires the image from items whose answer is text-driven, so we treat per-item vision-dependence as a design principle.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提出PRIME Bench,这是一个以大规模评价为辅的VLM分级基准压缩框架。 我们的方法利用了跨基准和内基准冗余。 在各种基准中,能力类别内的基准引起高度相关的模型排名(梁等人,2022年;波罗等人,2024年);我们用一个单一的代表性基准取代每个类别,并详尽地选择一个紧凑的子集,以保留全套订单。
在基准内,由所有模型解决或由所有模型失败的项目不带分离信号,而具有高模型差异的项目则主导排名质量;全错尾对今后的VLM评价具有诊断作用.
我们利用这些冗余性来进行一个针对VLM的考虑:只使用文本的大型语言模型(LLMs)的标准不能将答案需要图像的项目与答案由文本驱动的项目区分开来,因此,我们将每个项目的愿景依赖性视为一项设计原则。

blocks.en:
Our four-stage pipeline processes the score matrix end to end. Data Cleaning (Stage 0) removes items solvable without visual input and items answered correctly by every model. Category Representative Selection (Stage 1) picks one representative benchmark per category by correlation against the category mean, the average standardised score over the category’s benchmarks. Item Pruning with Vision-Aware Variance (Stage 2) first divides the category budget, the number of items the category keeps, among its benchmarks in proportion to their sizes, which gives each benchmark its share. Within each benchmark it groups the items into coverage cells (clusters of items with similar vision-text embeddings, one per item to keep) and keeps the highest-scoring item of each cell. The score is the inter-model variance plus a label-free vision-dependence prior, and the prior’s effective weight is annealed with the number of evaluated models so that it fades as variance estimates become reliable. Category-Count Pruning (Stage 3) selects a compact subset of category pools, yielding the released suite.
We validate the pipeline on a panel of 30 30 recent VLMs and its benchmark selection externally on a large public leaderboard, and complement it with diagnostic analyses that go beyond ranking and aim to inspire the design of next-generation VLM benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
我们的四阶段管道 处理得分矩阵结束。 数据清理(Stage 0)删除了没有视觉输入的可溶解项目,并且每个模型都正确回答项目. 类别代表选择(第1阶段)按每一类别相对于类别平均值,即该类别基准的平均标准分数,选择一个代表性基准。 项目“视距差异”(第2段)首先将类别预算、类别所保留项目的数目按其大小比例划分为基准,各基准所占份额均包括在内。 在每个基准中,它将项目分组为覆盖单元格(包含类似视觉文字嵌入的项目组,每个项目保留一个),并保留每个单元格的最高评分项目。 得分是模型间差异加上前一个无标签的视觉依赖,前一个的有效权重与被评价的模型数量相抵消,以便随着差异估计值变得可靠而消失. Category-Count Pruning (Stage 3) 选择一个紧凑的分类集合子集,产生释放的套件.
我们在一个由30个近期的VLM组成的小组中验证这一程序,并在一个大型公共领导板上进行外部基准选择,并辅之以诊断分析,这些分析超出了排名范围,旨在激励下一代VLM基准的设计。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold. 1. Open four-stage VLM compression pipeline. We release PRIMEBench, to our knowledge the first VLM compression suite that compresses both benchmarks and items, with an end-to-end evaluation of ranking preservation, including on models held out from selection, and a benchmark-level check on an external leaderboard. 2. Vision-Aware Variance (VAW), a variance-based item criterion with a label-free vision-dependence prior and coverage cells. VAW scores each item by its inter-model variance plus a vision-dependence prior computed from embeddings alone, whose effective weight shrinks as the number of models M M grows, and keeps one item per cell within each benchmark’s share. 3. Diagnostic analyses that guide future VLM evaluation. Beyond compression, our analyses explain where the gain of VAW comes from, test whether a compressed selection stays valid as new models arrive, and mark where compressed evaluation helps and where it stops, pointing to how evaluation suites can stay efficient as the model landscape changes.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
VLMs are now evaluated across a broad capability spectrum: general visual question answering ( Goyal et al., 2017 ; Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) , document and chart understanding ( Mathew et al., 2021 ; Masry et al., 2022 ) , and multi-discipline reasoning ( Yue et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Fu et al., 2025 ) .
Evaluating a single model now routinely spans 20+ benchmarks, with public leaderboards such as the OpenVLM leaderboard ( Duan et al., 2024 ) aggregating community results at increasing cost.
Discriminative signal diminishes as models improve, since competitive models increasingly solve the same items ( Kiela et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh:
现在对VLM进行了广泛的能力谱面的评价:一般视觉问题回答(Goyal等人,2017年;Hudson和Manning,2019年),文件和图表理解(Mathew等人,2021年;Masry等人,2022年),以及多学科推理(Yue等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年b;Fu等人,2025年).
评估单一模式现在通常跨越20+基准,公共领导板如OpenVLM领导板(Duan et al., 2024)以更高的成本汇总社区成果。
随着模型的改进,歧视性信号减少,因为竞争性模型越来越多地解决相同的项目(Kiela等人,2021年)。

blocks.en:
A growing body of work reduces evaluation cost by selecting item subsets, but almost exclusively for text-only LLMs.
Item-level criteria fall into families: item response theory (IRT) anchor selection (tinyBenchmarks ( Polo et al., 2024 ) , metabench ( Kipnis et al., 2025 ) ), inter-model-disagreement ranking (DISCO ( Rubinstein et al., 2026 ) ), genetic-algorithm search guided by sample attribution (EssenceBench ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ), sparse-anchor optimisation (SparseEval ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) ), rank-correlation prediction (SubLIME ( Saranathan et al., 2025 ) ), and embedding coverage (LMMs-Eval Lite ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) ).
Like tinyBenchmarks and DISCO, which evaluate a subset on models outside the set it was fitted on, we score every VLM selector on models unseen during selection.
For multimodal evaluation, prior work has proposed multimodal IRT that decomposes item difficulty into image-only, text-only, and cross-modal factors and uses it to select subsets (M3IRT ( Uebayashi et al., 2026 ) ), and applied point-biserial item discrimination to VLM benchmarks (DatBench ( Joshi et al., 2026 ) ); none releases a compressed suite that jointly compresses the benchmark axis (which benchmarks to keep) and the item axis (which items within each benchmark to retain), and DatBench’s correctness-only criterion remains vision-blind, ignoring whether an item’s answer requires the visual input. PRIMEBench unifies the two axes for multimodal evaluation and validates benchmark-level ranking preservation on a large external panel.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的工作通过选择项目子集来降低评价成本,但几乎只针对文本的LLMs.
项目级标准属于家族:项目响应理论(IRT)锚选择(Tiny Benchmarks(Polo等人,2024年),metabench(Kipnis等人,2025年)),模型间差异排名(DISCO(Rubinstein等人,2026年)),基因-算术搜索以样本归属为指导(Esssense Bench(Wang等人,2026年)),稀疏-选材优化(SparseEval(Zhang等人,2026年)),等级-算术预测(SubLIME(Saranathan等人,2025年)),嵌入覆盖(LMMS-Eval Lite(张等人,2025b)).
就像小奔驰和DISCO, 评估一个子集 在它安装的套装外的模型上, 我们给每个VLM选择器 评分 在选择过程中看不见的模型。
对于多式联运评价,先前的工作曾提议将项目难度分解为仅图像、仅文本和跨模式因素的多式联运IRT,并将其用于选择子集(M3IRT(Uebayashi等人,2026年)),并对VLM基准(Dat Bench (Joshi等人,2026年))适用点二项目区别;没有一种压缩的套房,共同压缩基准轴(该基准将保留)和项目轴(每个基准内的项目将保留),而Dat Bench的正确性只标准仍然是视盲的,而不管项目答案是否需要视觉输入。 PRIME Bench统一了多式联运评价的两个轴心,并在一个大型的外部面板上验证基准级别排序保全。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
Compression of a multi-benchmark VLM evaluation suite has two natural axes: which benchmarks to keep and which items within them to retain . Before either decision can be made, the item pool itself needs to be cleaned of items that no longer separate models or that admit a non-visual shortcut.
Our method therefore proceeds in four stages—data cleaning ( Section 4.1 ), category representative selection ( Section 4.2 ), item pruning with VAW ( Section 4.3 ), and category-count pruning ( Section 4.4 )—each motivated by a distinct property of VLM evaluation.
blocks.zh:
压缩一个多基准VLM评价套件有两个自然轴:哪些基准保留,哪些项目保留。 在作出任何决定之前,物品池本身需要清理不再单独使用模型或承认非视觉快捷方式的物品。
因此,我们的方法分四个阶段进行——数据清理(第4.1节)、类别代表选择(第4.2节)、与暴力侵害妇女问题核对项目(第4.3节)和类别核对(第4.4节)——每个阶段都由不同财产的VLM评价所驱动。

blocks.en: 4.1 Stage 0: Data cleaning
blocks.zh: 4.1 阶段0:数据清理

blocks.en: Stage 0 filters out benchmark items that do not carry useful evaluation signals. For example, the items that all models in ℳ \mathcal{M} can answer correctly may carry no useful information for ranking. Also, the items that can be answered correctly from the text alone may fall outside the scope of VLM evaluation—their solvability reflects language priors that are measured by LLM-only benchmarks already, not vision–language capability. This stage removes both populations to obtain a clean pool that measures VLM-specific capability. We use this pool as the reference for end-to-end evaluation.

blocks.en: Metrics and evaluation. Our primary metric is the Spearman rank correlation ( Spearman, 1904 ) between compressed- and full-pool model rankings. Each split partitions the 30 30 models into build and held-out sets, with Stage 2 selection performed only on the build models. For the Stage 2 comparison, all selectors operate on common category pools, built once on the full panel, and fidelity is measured on held-out models within each category. For end-to-end evaluation, Stages 1–3 are re-fitted on the build models and evaluated against the ranking from all Stage 0-cleaned benchmarks. Category pools retain at least 100 100 items, with smaller pools kept in full; the same floor applies to every selector. We report results over 20 20 balanced random 15 / 15 15/15 splits and a chronological split using the 15 15 oldest models for selection. Stage 0 cleaning and the released suite both use the full 30 30 -model panel. Additional protocol details are provided in Section D.3 .

blocks.en: The results show that PRIMEBench preserves model rankings at a fraction of the original evaluation cost. We ask why VAW works, whether the selection ages, what it misses, and where else it applies.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,PRIME Bench将模型排名保留在原评价成本的一小部分. 我们问,为什么暴力侵害妇女问题有效,选择年龄、错过什么,以及是否适用。

blocks.en: VAW is vision-aware in two places: its coverage cells are drawn on vision-text embeddings, and its score adds a vision-dependence tilt. At our panel size, most of the gain comes from the cells. In the held-out ablation ( Section D.4 ), VAW with benchmark shares alone reaches 0.908 0.908 at r = 5 % r{=}5\% , essentially matching Variance ( 0.906 0.906 ); adding vision-text coverage cells raises it to 0.925 0.925 and outperforms random partitions of the same size. The tilt follows a theoretical scaling with panel size M M : the plug-in variance concentrates at rate M − 1 / 2 M^{-1/2} , so VAW anneals the tilt at the same rate, α / M \alpha/\sqrt{M} , and its selection approaches the variance selector as M M grows. The OpenVLM scan shows that the best in-cell tilt tends to decrease with M M and is of the same order as the deployed α / M \alpha/\sqrt{M} on large panels. At r = 2 % r{=}2\% , the cross-seed-selected tilt improves ρ \rho over variance-only selection in the same cells at every tested size from M = 4 M{=}4 to 192 192 ; from M = 14 M{=}14 onward, the gain is 0.005 0.005 – 0.017 0.017 and exceeds two standard errors at every tested size. These results support smaller tilts on larger panels ( Sections F.2 and G ).

blocks.en: Stage 2 favours items that separate today’s models, so items that most current models still fail tend to be pruned, even though such hard cases may become informative as capabilities improve. We therefore release a second set, the Capability Frontier : among items that every current model family finds hard (each family’s mean score at most half the maximum, panel mean at least 0.10 0.10 ), we keep those with the largest difficulty-weighted variance (the plug-in variance times the mean shortfall 1 − x ¯ i 1-\bar{x}_{i} ); as a heuristic budget, the set size is the in-band pool size times the panel’s largest per-generation accuracy gain. The resulting 1,653 1{,}653 items still separate the oldest and newest Qwen generations ( Section I.2 ). Whether they will separate future models is untested, so we treat the set as a diagnostic of the current panel rather than a forecast.
blocks.zh: 第2阶段倾向于将今天的模型分开的项目,因此,大多数目前模型仍然失败的项目往往被挤压,尽管随着能力的提高,这些困难案件可能会成为信息。 因此,我们发布了第二套“能力边疆 ” : 在目前每个模型家族都发现困难的项目中(每个家族的平均得分最多一半,面板至少意味着0.100.10),我们保留那些难度最大的差异(插值差是平均不足1 - x i - bar{x}_{i} 的乘数);作为弹性预算,设定的大小是每代面板最大的准确度增益。 由此产生的1,653件1{,}653件物品仍然分离出最古老和最新的20代(第一节第2节)。 它们是否会分离未来的模型是未经测试的,所以我们把这套模型作为当前面板的诊断而不是预测.

blocks.en: Ranking fidelity is our primary objective, but benchmark scores may also support performance estimation. We predict a model’s score on a left-out OpenVLM benchmark from its scores on the others, and vary the number M M of models used to fit the predictor. The prediction error falls as M M grows ( Figure 4(a) ), paralleling LLM studies that estimate a benchmark score from a few of its items ( Polo et al., 2024 ; Rubinstein et al., 2026 ) ; our setting instead predicts across benchmarks. Because VLM leaderboards still have sparse cross-benchmark coverage, these estimates may improve as coverage grows. The predictors are full benchmark scores, not the released suite ( Section I.3 ).
blocks.zh: 排名忠诚是我们的首要目标,但基准分数也可能支持业绩估计。 我们从其他模型的分数中预测一个模型在左侧OpenVLM基准上的分数,并改变用于适应预测器的模型的MM数。 预测误差随着M M 的增长(图4(a))而下降,与估计其几个项目的基准分数的LLM研究平行(Polo等人,2024年;Rubinstein等人,2026年),我们的设定则预测跨越基准。 由于VLM领导板的跨基准覆盖范围仍然很少,这些估计值可能会随着覆盖面的增加而提高. 预测器是完整的基准分数,而不是发布的套件(第一节第3节)。

blocks.en: Model developers often use a benchmark to choose among checkpoints or hyper-parameters of one model rather than to rank model families, a harder test because such variants differ little. We fine-tune Qwen2-VL-2B on ScienceQA with LoRA (low-rank adaptation; rank 16 16 , two epochs) and form three kinds of variant sets: learning-rate grids , the final adapters of runs with 8 8 or 12 12 learning rates (a wide grid A and a narrower grid B, whose 12 12 -rate version is repeated with three training seeds); a trajectory of 8 8 checkpoints spread over one run; and the 12 12 -rate grid A repeated on Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct. No variant takes part in item selection, and we compare their ranking on the selected items with that on the full test set. On the eight variant sets whose full-test ranking is stable (bootstrap ρ ≥ 0.90 \rho\geq 0.90 ), VAW raises this ρ \rho over Variance by 0.082 0.082 on average at r = 5 % r{=}5\% ( Figure 4(b) ): it is ahead in six sets, behind on the 8 8 -rate grid B and level on the 3B grid, and its lead ranges from 0.04 0.04 to 0.28 0.28 across the three seeds of the 12 12 -rate grid B ( Section I.4 ). Here only 8 8 or 12 12 closely related variants are ranked, so a few uninformative items can more easily reorder them; VAW’s gain over Variance here is about four times its gain on the broader model panel ( 0.019 0.019 ). The two settings differ and the variants of one run are not independent draws, so this comparison is descriptive, but it suggests that VAW may be particularly useful for ranking small sets of closely related model variants.
blocks.zh: 模型开发者经常使用基准在一个模型的检查站或超参数中进行选择,而不是对模型家族进行排位,这是一个更难的测试,因为这些变体差异很小. 我们对科学QA上的Qune2-VL-2B进行微调(低排名的适应;排名16,两个纪元),并形成三种变体:学习率网格,8或12个学习率(宽网格A和较窄的网格B,其中12个12速率版重复使用3个训练种子);8个检查站的轨迹分布在一次运行中;12个12速率网格A重复使用Quen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct. 没有任何变体参加项目选择,我们比较了它们在选定项目上的排名和在全套测试集上的排名。 在8套测试排位稳定的变种(bootstrap à ^ 0.90\rho\geq 0.90)上,VAW比差异平均提高0.082 0.082 = 5% r%= 5%(图4(b)): 它在6组中领先,落后于8 8 速率电网B和3 B 速率电网的电位,在12 12 速率电网B的3个种子中,其领先范围为0.04 0.04至0.28 0.28(I.4节)。 这里只有8个8个或12个密切相关的变体排名,因此少数非信息化项目可以更容易地重新排列它们;在这里,VAW相对于差异的增益大约是它在更广泛的模型面板(0.019 0.019)上的增益的四倍. 这两个设置不同,一个运行的变体不是独立的图纸,因此这种比较是描述性的,但这表明,VAW可能特别有助于对一些关系密切的模型变体进行排序.

blocks.en: An item score that finds informative evaluation items could in principle also select informative training data. We fine-tune a SigLIP+BERT multiple-choice model on ScienceQA training subsets chosen by six selectors (Random, Variance, VAW, DatBench r p ​ b r_{pb} , AnchorPoints and IRT 2PL) at retentions from 5 % 5\% to 90 % 90\% , with three seeds. No selector beats random sampling by more than the seed spread, and Variance trails it by 10.5 10.5 – 20.2 20.2 points of test accuracy at r ≤ 30 % r\leq 30\% ( Section I.5 ). Training selection and evaluation compression are distinct problems : the former rewards informative training examples, the latter items that separate models. We therefore do not recommend VAW or other evaluation-side scores for training-data pruning; uniform random sampling remains the safer baseline there.
blocks.zh: 发现信息性评价项目的项目分数原则上也可以选择信息性培训数据。 由六位选手(Random, Difficiation, VAW, Dat Bench r p b r r r r pb}, AnchorPoints 和 IRT 2PL)选择的 SigLIP+BERT 多选择子集的ScienceQA 模型进行微调,保留率从 5% +% 到 90% 90 +%,并有 3 个种子. 任何选择者都不得比种子传播多随机取样,而差异则以10.5 10.5 – 20.2 20.2 点的测试精度在r 30% r\leq 30 + 中(第一节第5节)。 培训选择和评价压缩是明显的问题:前者奖励信息丰富的培训实例,后者则奖励不同的模式。 因此,我们不建议对暴力侵害妇女问题或其他评价方面的评分进行培训数据调查;统一随机抽样仍然是那里比较安全的基线。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We presented PRIMEBench , a vision-aware hierarchical framework for compressing VLM evaluation across both benchmarks and items. Its four-stage pipeline reduces the items of the original 43 43 -benchmark suite by over 97 % 97\% while closely preserving model rankings, and its item selector, Vision-Aware Variance, performs best at the released 5 % 5\% retention on models held out from selection. We further validate the benchmark-level compression mechanism on a substantially larger external OpenVLM panel.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了PRIME Bench,这是一个具有远见的分级框架,用于压缩对基准和项目进行的VLM评价。 它的四级管道将最初的43个基准套件的项目减少97%以上,同时密切维护模型排名,其项目选择者Vision-Aware Difference在被选中的模型上保存5% 5 ==== 表现最好。 我们进一步验证一个大得多的外部OpenVLM面板的基准级压缩机制。

blocks.en: Overall, our results show that hierarchical compression can substantially reduce the cost of broad VLM evaluation while retaining the ranking information needed to compare new models. Practical limitations and broader implications are discussed in Appendices J and K .
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的结果表明,分级压缩可以大大减少广义的VLM评价成本,同时保留比较新模型所需的排名信息. 附录J和K讨论了实际限制和更广泛的影响。

blocks.en: A split divides the panel into build models, which select the items, and held-out models, which are scored. Selection reads only the build columns. Stages 0 and 1 use the responses of the whole panel and are run once, so the pools are fixed before any split; the cells use no model responses, and every variance, IRT or AnchorPoints clustering fit uses the build models alone. The protocol therefore tests Stage 2 selection on unseen models, not the construction of the pools; the end-to-end protocol below refits Stages 1 to 3 on the build models. For each category we compute the Spearman correlation over the held-out models between their mean on the full pool and their mean on the selected items, and average over the categories with a finite value. A category whose correlation is undefined in a split, because every held-out model receives the same score on the selected items, is left out of that split’s mean. blocks.en: Stage 3 enumerates all ( 18 k ) \binom{18}{k} category subsets ( Equation 7 ) on the Stage 2 output at r = 5 % r{=}5\% ; for k = 5 k{=}5 it enumerates 8,568 8{,}568 subsets. Exact ties in ρ \rho are broken by taking the first subset in alphabetical category order. We report two correlations for each k k ( Table 15 ). The Stage 3 convention compares the ranking by the k k selected pruned categories with the ranking by all 18 18 pruned categories, which is the quantity the search maximises. blocks.en: Theorem 3 shows that the annealed tilt approaches the population variance selector at large M M when all terms of its bound vanish; for a fixed pool under the boundary-gap condition (A3), Proposition 1 gives exact recovery. At the panel sizes used here ( M ≤ 30 M\leq 30 with pools of 90 90 items or more in our panel, and up to 265 265 models with pools of 218 218 items or more on OpenVLM), the union-bound radius over all items used in Proposition 1 at confidence 0.95 0.95 exceeds 1 / 8 1/8 , half the largest possible gap between two variances, so the bounds describe the large- M M regime and give no finite-sample guarantee at these panel sizes. The analysis does not show that variance selection is the strongest selector at large M M , which would need a minimax lower bound, nor that the tilt improves on variance at small M M , which would need a finite-sample risk bound; the properties above bound the effect of the tilt in the limit under these conditions and do not show that it helps. Whether it helps is an empirical question, answered by the scan of Appendix G . The results also differ in kind from the IRT-based selection of tinyBenchmarks ( Polo et al., 2024 ) and metabench ( Kipnis et al., 2025 ) , which fit a parametric response model and select items with it. Our statements assume no ability model and bound the estimation error of a model-free item statistic. Four limits apply. The pool is chosen with model responses: Stage 0 removes items by their responses, Stage 1 picks benchmarks by response correlations and adds supplements in descending variance of the same scores ( Section C.2 ), so A1 is assumed for the fixed pool rather than inherited from the pipeline. A1 also treats the models as independent draws, while models of one family share architecture and data, so the effective panel size is smaller than M M ; extending the bounds to dependent families would need a dependence model and a matching concentration bound, which we do not provide. The margin constant L V L_{V} of A4 is a population quantity that we do not estimate. The bounds hold within one pool, and transfer across pools requires the distribution of ( v i , δ i VL ) (v_{i},\delta_{i}^{\mathrm{VL}}) to be stable.

blocks.en: The Capability Frontier collects the items that most current VLMs fail. The Frontier selects only from the 16,692 of them with a panel mean score in [ 0.10 , 0.50 ] [0.10,0.50] , which excludes items that almost every model fails, and keeps those with the largest difficulty-weighted variance v ^ i ​ ( 1 − x ¯ i ) \widehat{v}_{i}(1-\bar{x}_{i}) . As a heuristic budget, its size applies the largest per-step accuracy gain along the panel’s model axes, the Qwen per-generation gain on the full pool ( Table 21 ), to this in-band pool, so that 16,692 × \times 0.09902 gives 1,653 items.

blocks.en: Appendix K Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录 K 宽度 影响

blocks.en: PRIMEBench lowers the cost of VLM evaluation by replacing repeated full-suite evaluation with a compact, ranking-preserving subset. This can make systematic VLM evaluation more accessible to small-budget research groups, reduce duplicated GPU expenditure across model releases, and lower the environmental cost of large-scale benchmarking. The released suite also provides a common reference point for comparing new models without requiring every group to rerun hundreds of thousands of benchmark items.
blocks.zh: PRIME Bench通过用紧凑的,保级子集取代重复的全集评价,降低了VLM评价的成本. 这可以使小型预算研究小组更容易获得系统VLM评价,减少模型发布过程中重复的GPU支出,降低大规模基准化的环境成本. 发行的套件也为比较新模型提供了一个共同的参考点,而不需要每个组重新运行数十万个基准项目.

blocks.en: The main risk is that aggressive compression may narrow the community’s attention towards capabilities that are already well represented in existing benchmarks. A compact suite should therefore not be treated as a substitute for comprehensive evaluation in high-stakes deployment settings or for auditing newly emerging capabilities. To mitigate this, PRIMEBench is released as a hierarchical pipeline rather than only as a fixed item set: users can stop at less compressed stages when broader coverage is required, and future versions can refresh the item pool as new model families and new capability axes appear.
blocks.zh: 主要的风险是,积极的压缩可能缩小社区对在现有基准中已经得到充分体现的能力的关注。 因此,不应把一套紧凑的套件作为在高额部署环境中进行综合评价或审计新兴能力的替代物。 为了缓解这种情况,PRIME Bench作为分级管道而不是仅仅作为固定项目集发布:用户在需要更广泛的覆盖时可以停在压缩较少的阶段,未来版本可以随着新模型家庭和新能力轴的出现而刷新项目池.
